ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti by Border Patrol agents in Minneapolis.
ideas.angle: Use of force by law enforcement
questions: What were the circumstances leading up to the shooting?
Was the use of force justified?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the use of force by law enforcement and potential irregularities in the handling of immigration cases.

ideas.title: Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the $380 million in Medicaid billing linked to a single Minnesota building.
questions: How did this building accumulate such a large amount of Medicaid billing?
Are there any connections to other entities or individuals?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate potential Medicaid fraud and irregularities in child care billing.
